charging_sessions_battery_range_check.name: charging_sessions_battery_range_check
charging_sessions_battery_range_check.value: ("charging_sessions"."start_battery_level" is null or "charging_sessions"."start_battery_level" between 0 and 100) and ("charging_sessions"."end_battery_level" is null or "charging_sessions"."end_battery_level" between 0 and 100)

charging_sessions_non_negative_check.name: charging_sessions_non_negative_check
charging_sessions_non_negative_check.value: "charging_sessions"."energy_delivered_kwh" >= 0 and ("charging_sessions"."electricity_price" is null or "charging_sessions"."electricity_price" >= 0) and ("charging_sessions"."total_cost" is null or "charging_sessions"."total_cost" >= 0)

dashboard_password_credentials_email_che.name: dashboard_password_credentials_email_check
dashboard_password_credentials_email_che.value: "dashboard_password_credentials"."email" = lower("dashboard_password_credentials"."email") and char_length("dashboard_password_credentials"."email") between 3 and 320 and position('@' in "dashboard_password_credentials"."email") > 1

device_addresses_coordinates_check.name: device_addresses_coordinates_check
device_addresses_coordinates_check.value: "device_addresses"."latitude" between -90 and 90 and "device_addresses"."longitude" between -180 and 180 and "device_addresses"."public_latitude" between -90 and 90 and "device_addresses"."public_longitude" between -180 and 180

device_addresses_lengths_check.name: device_addresses_lengths_check
device_addresses_lengths_check.value: char_length("device_addresses"."formatted_address") between 1 and 300 and ("device_addresses"."unit" is null or char_length("device_addresses"."unit") <= 40)

device_events_record_commitment_check.name: device_events_record_commitment_check
device_events_record_commitment_check.value: ("device_events"."payload_version" = 1 and "device_events"."record_hash" is null and "device_events"."record_salt" is null and "device_events"."record_json" is null) or ("device_events"."payload_version" = 2 and "device_events"."record_hash" is not null and "device_events"."record_salt" is not null and "device_events"."record_json" is not null)

device_events_confirmed_has_tx_check.name: device_events_confirmed_has_tx_check
device_events_confirmed_has_tx_check.value: "device_events"."status" <> 'confirmed' or ("device_events"."transaction_hash" is not null and "device_events"."token_id" is not null and "device_events"."confirmed_at" is not null)

devices_located_sort_idx.name: devices_located_sort_idx
devices_located_sort_idx.where: "devices"."last_latitude" is not null and "devices"."last_longitude" is not null
